scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && cp alarme.wav www/alarme.wav && cp ota-update.js www/ota-update.js && cp manifest.json www/manifest.json && cp erimax-pwa.svg www/erimax-pwa.svg && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('www/ota-build.json', JSON.stringify({bundleId:process.env.ERIMAX_BUILD_ID || 'development'}))" && npx esbuild export-bridge.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=www/export-bridge.js && cp erimax-android-bridge.js www/erimax-android-bridge.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='www/index.html';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const tag='<script src=\\\"/erimax-android-bridge.js\\\"></script>';if(!s.includes(tag))s=s.replace(/<\\/body>/i,tag+'</body>');if(!s.includes(tag))throw new Error('Não foi possível instalar o bridge EriMax');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);"
